_comment: HQ-1042. The home bus routes. Empty because nobody has the current ones.
The app's Home segment has been blank since e2dd6c4 (2024-09-14), which replaced a
working PM shuttle list with two empty headers and never filled them in. The 2022 times
are recoverable from git but are not written here on purpose: publishing times nobody
has confirmed in three years is how somebody misses a bus.
To fill this in: get the current routes from BB&N, delete this _comment key, add them
below in the shape shown in shuttle.json, then run
Every time needs departure and arrival. Everything else is optional:
departureSpot   names where it leaves from, when that is not obvious
arrivalTwo      a second stop, which REQUIRES arrivalTwoSpot alongside it
weekDays        e.g. "Tuesday" or "Wed/Fri". Left out means every weekday.
For reference, what the app showed before it was emptied:
PM Shuttle, Upper School to Boston:  6:15 PM -> 6:45 PM at Charles St. @ Beacon St.
PM Shuttle, Upper School to Newton:  6:15 PM -> 6:40 PM at Riverside, Newton (M/Tu/Th)
